longdesc:
Create a SBD STONITH resource. SBD must be configured to use a
particular shared storage device using /etc/sysconfig/sbd.

This wizard can optionally create and configure a SBD device. A shared
device must be available and visible on all nodes.

For more information, see http://www.linux-ha.org/wiki/SBD_Fencing or
the sbd(8) manual page.
name: sbd

steps.longdesc:
Optional step to initialize and configure the SBD Device.

Prerequisites:

  * The environment must have shared storage reachable by all nodes.
steps.name: sbd-device
